title: SPR Experiment Conditions
description: A schema to store experimental conditions for a Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) assay, based on published literature.

pmid.description: The PubMed ID of the publication.

instrument.description: Details about the SPR instrument used.

manufacturer.description: e.g., GE Healthcare, Cytiva, Biacore AB, PlexArrayTM

model.description: e.g., Biacore T200, Biacore 8K, BIAcore 3000, PlexArrayTM HT SPRi

type.description: The type of sensor chip surface.

immobilization.description: Details about the molecule immobilized on the chip (the ligand).

ligand_name.description: The name of the protein, compound, or molecule attached to the chip.

strategy.description: The chemical or affinity method used for immobilization.

density_ru.description: The immobilization level in Response Units (RU). Use a string to capture ranges or approximations.

concentration_for_immobilization.description: The concentration of the ligand used during the immobilization step, including units.

analyte.description: Details about the molecule in solution being tested (the analyte).

description.description: A general description of the analyte(s).

concentration_range.description: The range of concentrations tested, described as text.

running_buffer_composition.description: The full composition of the running buffer, including additives (e.g., DMSO, Tween). Exclude pH here; use the separate pH field.

pH.description: The pH of the running buffer.

assay_type.description: The type of kinetic experiment performed.

assay_flow_rate.description: The flow rate used during the analyte injection.

temperature_c.description: The temperature of the experiment. Use a string to allow for 'room temperature'.

association_time_s.description: The contact/association time in seconds. Use a string to capture ranges.

dissociation_time_s.description: The dissociation time in seconds. Use a string to capture ranges.

regeneration_solution.description: The composition of the solution used to regenerate the chip surface.

data_analysis.description: Details about how the raw data was processed and modeled.

reference_description.description: Description of the reference surface or channel used for subtraction.

fitting_model.description: The kinetic or affinity model used to fit the data.

software.description: The software used for data analysis.
